newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FIRMER AFTER THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FIRMER AFTER THIN TRADE.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,496-1,503 per dollar in very thin interbank volume on Saturday, a touch firmer from 1,495-1,505 at the opening due to low foreign currency demand, dealers said.
"The market was dormant today with most trades around 1,500. The lev edged up as dollar supply topped demand in very light volumes," a commercial bank dealer said.
The local market was open after a long holiday for Orthodox Easter and Labour Day from Monday through Thursday. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
